name: Kanata Fukushima
source: The brother of Shion that goes to the same school as her. They both loved each other until one day a disabily affecting his elbow forced him to give up on his dream of becoming a professional baseball player. His own anger and frustration as a result makes him go paranoid thinking someone is to blame and their relationship starts to fall apart as he starts beating and mistreating her sister.
